==Dialogue==
If The Toy's Story has not not been completed:
:''"No one buys my dad's toys anymore. He says the world's gotten too serious. Can you help us? I can't offer much, but if you have a [[Broken Toy|broken toy]], I'm sure my [[Mahk|dad]] could fix it!"''

If you have the [[Broken Toy]] item in your inventory:
:'''What about this broken toy I found?'''
::''"Ooh! That's one of my dad's mini gray giants.  He told me all about the giant's of the [[Gray Oasis of Giyah|Gray Oasis]] when he first made that.  They used to collect tribute and slaves from other tribes in [[the Desolation]].  But [[Palawa Joko]] killed most of them and turned them into undead servants.  The undead [[Awakened Gray Giant|Gray Giants]] threw boulders and stomped entire armies when Palawa invaded [[Elona]].  My friend says some of the [[undead]] [[giant]]s still roam the Desolation looking for people to stomp.  Too bad dad could never get that toy to work.  It would be soooo cool!"''

If The Toy's Story has been completed:
:''"Thanks for helping my dad. He's the best. Have fun with your gray giant!"''
